cards.ex: The two companies have been at loggerheads over patent rights for years.
cards.exUz: Ikki kompaniya patent huquqlari bo'yicha yillar davomida kelisha olmayapti.
cards.uzDef: Biror masala bo'yicha qattiq kelishmovchilikda bo'lish, murosaga kelmaslik.

cards.ex: Our team beat their team hands down in the championship game.
cards.exUz: Bizning jamoa chempionat o'yinida ularning jamoasini juda osonlik bilan yutdi.
cards.uzDef: Raqibni juda osonlik bilan, hech qanday qiyinchiliksiz mag'lub etmoq.

cards.ex: International trade shouldn't be a zero-sum game; everyone should benefit.
cards.exUz: Xalqaro savdo nol yig'indi o'yin bo'lmasligi kerak; hamma foyda ko'rishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Bir tomonning yutug'i boshqa tomonning yo'qotishi hisobiga bo'ladigan vaziyat.

cards.ex: The politicians locked horns over the proposed tax reforms.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchilar taklif qilingan soliq islohotlari bo'yicha qattiq bahslashishdi.
cards.uzDef: Qattiq bahslashmoq, kurashmoq, ayniqsa qarama-qarshi fikrlar bilan.

cards.ex: He always felt he was living in his older brother's shadow.
cards.exUz: U har doim o'zini akasining soyasida yashayotgandek his qilardi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir yutug'i yoki obro'si tufayli e'tibordan chetda qolish.

cards.ex: Her English has improved by leaps and bounds since she started taking lessons.
cards.exUz: U dars boshlaganidan beri ingliz tili tez rivojlandi.
cards.uzDef: Tez va sezilarli darajada yaxshilanish yoki rivojlanish.

cards.ex: The election is shaping up to be a two-horse race between the incumbent and the challenger.
cards.exUz: Saylov amaldagi va nomzod o'rtasidagi ikki otli poyga shaklini olmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Faqat ikki nomzod yoki guruh g'alaba qozonish ehtimoli yuqori bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: Everyone in the sales team is out for the top spot this quarter.
cards.exUz: Sotuv bo'limidagi har bir xodim bu chorakda eng yuqori o'rin uchun kurashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Eng yaxshi natijaga erishish uchun kurashish, birinchi o'rinni egallashga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Our company has taken the lead in developing new technologies.
cards.exUz: Bizning kompaniya yangi texnologiyalarni ishlab chiqishda yetakchilikni oldi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalardan oldinga o'tib, birinchi o'rinni egallamoq.

cards.ex: The rival factions within the party were constantly undermining each other.
cards.exUz: Partiyadagi raqib guruhlar doimo bir-biriga to'sqinlik qilishardi.
cards.uzDef: Bir maqsadga erishish uchun kurashayotgan dushmanlikdagi guruhlar.

cards.ex: He has a strong competitive spirit and always wants to win.
cards.exUz: Uda kuchli raqobat ruhi bor va u doimo g'alaba qozonishni xohlaydi.
cards.uzDef: G'alaba qozonish va boshqalardan ustun bo'lishga intilish.

cards.ex: Smaller companies are nipping at the heels of the market leader.
cards.exUz: Kichikroq kompaniyalar bozor yetakchisining ortidan quvmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Kimdirdan unchalik orqada bo'lmaslik, yaqinlashib kelayotgan xavf tug'dirish.

cards.ex: The new product's sales have outstripped all our expectations.
cards.exUz: Yangi mahsulotning sotuvi bizning barcha umidlarimizdan oshib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilgan natijalardan yuqori natijalarga erishmoq.

cards.ex: The gloves are off in the mayoral race; the attacks are getting personal.
cards.exUz: Mer saylovida urush boshlandi; hujumlar shaxsiy tus olmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ochiqchasiga va shafqatsiz kurash boshlandi.

cards.ex: They're fighting a losing battle against the new regulations.
cards.exUz: Ular yangi qoidalarga qarshi befoyda kurashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: G'alaba qozonish imkoniyati bo'lmagan kurash olib borish.

cards.ex: The opposition party is slowly gaining ground in the polls.
cards.exUz: Muxolifat partiyasi so'rovlarda sekin-asta o'rin egallamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Rivojlanish, yutuqlarga erishish, kuchayish.

cards.ex: They keep moving the goalposts, making it impossible to succeed.
cards.exUz: Ular qoidalarni o'zgartirishda davom etmoqdalar, bu muvaffaqiyatga erishishni imkonsiz qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Qoidalarni o'zgartirish, maqsadga erishishni qiyinlashtirish.

cards.ex: It was such a close race, it ended in a photo finish.
cards.exUz: Poyga shunchalik yaqin ediki, u juda yaqin natija bilan yakunlandi.
cards.uzDef: G'olibni aniqlash uchun fotoga qarash kerak bo'lgan poyga yoki musobaqa.

cards.ex: Our company gets the lion's share of the government contracts.
cards.exUz: Bizning kompaniya hukumat shartnomalarining ulushining ko'pini oladi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning eng katta qismi.

cards.ex: We need to outmaneuver the competition to win this contract.
cards.exUz: Biz bu shartnomani yutish uchun raqibni aldashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Raqobatda hiyla ishlatib ustun kelmoq, raqibdan aqlliroq harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: We need to level the playing field so small businesses can compete.
cards.exUz: Biz kichik bizneslar raqobatlasha olishi uchun sharoitlarni tenglashtirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Barcha ishtirokchilar uchun teng imkoniyatlar yaratish.

cards.ex: They came up short in the final game and lost the championship.
cards.exUz: Ular final o'yinida yetishmadilar va chempionatda mag'lub bo'lishdi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilgan darajaga yetishmaslik, maqsadga erisha olmaslik.

cards.ex: The negotiations became a battle of wills between the two leaders.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralar ikki lider o'rtasida iroda kurashiga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Qaysarlik va qat'iyatlilik asosida bo'ladigan kurash.

cards.ex: She's definitely one to watch in the world of tennis.
cards.exUz: U, albatta, tennis olamida diqqatga sazovor.
cards.uzDef: Katta muvaffaqiyatga erishishi kutilayotgan odam yoki narsa.

cards.ex: After the scandal, he's out of the running for the presidency.
cards.exUz: Janjaldan so'ng, u prezidentlik uchun kurashdan chiqib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: G'alaba qozonish imkoniyatini yo'qotish, musobaqadan chetlashtirilish.

cards.ex: If you play your cards right, you could get a promotion.
cards.exUz: Agar siz to'g'ri harakat qilsangiz, lavozimga ko'tarilishingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ri strategiyani tanlab muvaffaqiyatga erishish.

cards.ex: The two companies are striving for dominance in the smartphone market.
cards.exUz: Ikki kompaniya smartfon bozorida hukmronlikka intilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Bir sohada yoki bozorda yetakchi o'rinni egallashga intilish.

cards.ex: Their innovative technology keeps them ahead of the pack.
cards.exUz: Ularning innovatsion texnologiyasi ularni oldingi safda ushlab turadi.
cards.uzDef: O'z sohasida boshqalardan oldinda bo'lish, yetakchilik qilish.

cards.ex: He won the election by a narrow margin of victory.
cards.exUz: U saylovda kichik g'alaba farqi bilan g'alaba qozondi.
cards.uzDef: G'alabaga erishish uchun zarur bo'lgan ustunlik darajasi.

cards.ex: The new regulations threw a wrench in our expansion plans.
cards.exUz: Yangi qoidalar bizning kengaytirish rejamizga to'sqinlik qildi.
cards.uzDef: Rejalarni buzish, muammolar yaratish, ishni chigallashtirmoq.
